# Purina US

> Purina offers nutritious dog and cat food products, treats, and pet wellness solutions with veterinary-backed formulas and a myPurina loyalty program.

Purina US is the primary destination for pet nutrition products from Nestle Purina PetCare Company. The site features comprehensive product catalogs, veterinary professional programs, and direct-to-consumer shopping across multiple brands including Pro Plan, Purina ONE, and specialty treat lines.

## Key Topics

- Pro Plan
- Dog Food
- Cat Food
- myPurina Loyalty Program
- Puppy Food
- Senior Dog Food
- Dog Treats
- Wet Dog Food
- Dry Dog Food
- Prescription Diets
- Sensitive Stomach & Skin
- Grain-Free Options
- Dental Chews
- Veterinary Professionals
- Pet Nutrition

## Dog Food Products

- [All Dog Food Products](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food): Complete Purina dog food product catalog with filtering and comparison.
- [Our Dry Dog Food Brands](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food/dry): Purina dry dog food catalog including Pro Plan and specialty formulas.
- [All Wet Dog Food Products](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food/wet): Purina wet and canned dog food products with Pro Plan options.
- [All Puppy Food Products](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food/puppy-food): Purina puppy food formulas for growth and development.
- [All Senior Dog Food Products](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food/senior): Pro Plan senior dog food with age-specific nutrition formulas.
- [Grain Free Dog Food](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food/grain-free): Grain-free dog food options from Purina ONE and Pro Plan brands.
- [Dog Food for Sensitive Stomach & Skin](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-food/sensitive-skin-stomach): Pro Plan sensitive stomach and skin dog food formulas.
- [Pro Plan Veterinary Diets Prescription Dog Food](https://www.purina.com/pro-plan-vet/diets/products/dog-food): Pro Plan Veterinary Diets prescription dog food for health conditions.

## Dog Treats

- [All Treats for Dogs & Puppies](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-treats): Complete Purina dog treats catalog with chews, jerky, and dental options.
- [All Chew Treats for Dogs](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-treats/chews): Purina dog chew treats including Beggin' and Busy Bone brands.
- [All Dog Jerky & Strips](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-treats/jerky-strips): Purina dog jerky and strip treats in various flavors.
- [Rawhide & Rollhide Dog Treats](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-treats/rawhides-rollhides): Busy Bone rawhide and rollhide chew treats for dogs.
- [All Dog Dental Chews & Treats](https://www.purina.com/dogs/dog-treats/dental-chews): DentaLife dental chews for plaque reduction and oral health.

## Shopping & Professional Programs

- [Shop Select Purina Brand Stores](https://www.purina.com/where-to-buy/shop-brand-stores): Direct shopping for Purina brands including Pro Plan and Petivity products.
- [Purina for Veterinary Professionals](https://www.purina.com/where-to-buy/for-professionals): Purina Pro Plan programs and enrollment for veterinary professionals.
